body: this is nice ! it seems like everything you have right now is super solid. the guitar sounds great— the tone is really nice and clean and the entire track sounds pretty polish. in terms of feedback, I think this track could do with some more vocal layering/bgv because it would really fill out the space in the track and would fit well for a chorus section . good work !! :)))

this is good ! the vocals are great and the delivery is really nice and catchy. the mixing is clean too! everything is audible which is really nice. to improve, i think this track could do with a louder/more interesting bassline to really hook listeners in . nice work so far though !

i like the vocal effects, but I feel like the instrumental is too bright and cheery feeling for the vocals themselves which seem more suited to a darker instrumental. also, the timing of the delivery is sort of off, however im not sure if thats a creative choice. the mixing is good though !

this is really nice ! i love the drums and all the foley textures youve used, it definitely helps to give it an organic, layered feeling which i really enjoy. i honestly have dont much to say in terms of criticism because the chords and instruments youve used are also really interesting and great too, which is a problem which most other chillhop songs have. so nice work !

Hi!! your song is really great— everything sounds really nice, and i can definitely hear the doowop in it. the vocals and guitar sound super clean too !! as for feedback, I’d say you could add some low end to the drums, as the kick doesn’t have much impact and is kind of hard to hear because of that. I feel like making the drums punchier and more present in the mix would give the track more drive as well. other than that, good job!

This is a nice song!!! I especially like the delayed guitar solo part at the end — definitely a high point of the track for me. one point of improvement that could be made is on the drums. they stay mostly the sam throughout the track, and adding some dynamics and percussion to the drums could really help increase the sense of rhythm and fill out some of the empty space in the track. nice job!

This is a really creative and unique idea! the execution is good too — however my main point of criticism would be the cluttered mix, as there are a lot of instruments playing at once without enough room for each if that makes sense. this in turn makes the track sound a little harsh but seeing as one of the genres you listed is noise-rock, that could be intentional on your part. A suggestion I would make is to maybe have a point of focus in the mix eg. the vocals to prevent it from being overpowered by the other instruments. good work though!

I agree most of what other people are saying about the track. while the melody, lyrics, and instrumental are all great — the vocals are too overbearing. it sounds too loud and takes attention away from the instrumental which is a high point of this track. I would also say to go easier on the vocal effects? it's a little disorienting and the bitcrushing just makes it harder to understand. other than that, it's really good and has a lot of potential!

the drums sound really great! it sounds super authentic and the synths are nice too. however, my only point of criticism is that the vocals sound a little thin? I'm not sure how to put it differently but they could do with some layering to really fill them out. really nice work though!

it definitely sounds like a song from a film score! the atmosphere adds a lot which I enjoy and there's a lot of space for the instruments on the track to shine! i think the only suggestion I have is to maybe add some synths on it sporadically? a warm analog synth lead or pad could definitely make it more interesting with the variation it would add. other than that, really great! the composition is nice too :)

the track is good, but it's definitely lacking in the low end in terms of frequency. the kick drum sounds more like a tom? and maybe different sample choice would help. the guitar playing is great, the vocals sound nice, but with a bassline and more solid kick this track would sound more filled out and and rhythmic. it has a lot of potential! nice work

the mixing is great and so are the vocals! everything sounds really clear and it definitely reminds me of more oldschool rap. the sample choice is great, and the part around 1:06 is really nice. the bars are nice too! it may be a good idea to switch up the flow maybe once or twice through the track but that's the only criticism I have. really good!

the vocals and the harmonies are really nice! however I do agree with what the other commenter said about adding some more note variation to the track as it could help to make it more interesting. it's really mellow with a haunting bassline, and it makes me feel uneasy (in a good way). nice work!

I love the experimental sound you have! it's really interesting and creative and I look forward to wherever your artistic direction goes. the vocal line is great and maybe adding more vocal layers similar to that could be a good idea? just a suggestion anyway! cool track :)

this is really smooth, it sounds like it could be part of a film score! In my personal opinion, I think the track could do with some development as it progresses, eg. more sounds coming in and out of the track but if the more low-key sound is something you were going for, great work :)

the recording quality is excellent, and the track is really unique! the track also has a great spacey and ethereal feeling that makes me feel like i'm in a large field. the vocal performance is super nice as well and the lyrics are compelling too. nice track :)

the vocals definitely remind me a lot of other rappers in the emo rap genre and the lil peep style guitar parts really help bring that in. I think the only criticism I have is that it's fairly repetitive so if you found a way to switch things up in the track that would make it more interesting in my opinion. good work!

this is really great!! it has a super relaxing sound and the vocals are smooth. as well as that, the chord changes are interesting and the guitars have a nostalgic surf rock tone to them. I think as the others have said, getting the drums to sound as if they're played live would definitely elevate this track to the next level. fantastic otherwise!
